name: Voxelmon Demo
summary:
Version 1.0.0: Demo launch
- Full tutorial camp with your mentor Karagra
- Choose your first Voxelmon
- Hands-on crafting: mining, smelting, smithing, carpentry and fletching
- Sword and shield combat, and archery
- Farming, brewing, fishing and cooking
- A real backpack you take off your back and open
- Free play around the camp once the tutorial is done
